stemMd: A paragraph opens, "The pond changes dramatically through the year." Which order produces the clearest chronological development? Sentences: [1] Autumn leaves form a floating carpet. [2] Summer brings thick clusters of water lilies. [3] In spring, frogs begin calling. [4] Winter ice seals the surface.
explanationMd: Starting with spring, follow the seasons through summer, autumn, and winter. That chronological sequence makes the yearly change easy to trace.

distractorRationale.d: This jumps directly from winter to summer and ends by returning to spring.
distractorRationale.a: This jumps from autumn to spring to winter to summer.
distractorRationale.b: This skips between seasons rather than following the yearly sequence.
